not_affected.disc2_3dcbcf6d0be08b1865d2a173: XSS in the debug page information through a Tippy.js tooltip configured with allowHTML: true. The OSV range says introduced 0, fixed 12.69.0, which nominally contains v11.30.0; the source does not. The fix b495ca2ec4e1 (PR #61381) does two things: it renames the tooltip attribute in formatted-source.blade.php from data-tippy-content to data-tippy-html-content, and it splits the single tippy() call that had allowHTML: true into two, with allowHTML: false for data-tippy-content. Neither part exists in the frozen v11.30.0 tree: there is no formatted-source.blade.php component, no allowHTML option in the renderer source, and the shipped bundle src/Illuminate/Foundation/resources/exceptions/renderer/dist/scripts.js contains only allowHTML:!1 (false). The only tippy targets at v11.30.0 are context.blade.php:20 and :74, whose data-tippy-content values are Blade-escaped {{ }} header and route names. With allowHTML disabled tippy renders content as text, so no markup from the page can execute. The vulnerable tooltip is a later renderer feature; v11.30.0 is not affected.
not_affected.adv3_64602c927aaf2245: Unauthorized data destruction through relationship inclusion on a read endpoint. The OSV record carries two ranges: introduced 12.45.0, fixed 12.68.0, and introduced 13.0.0, fixed 13.27.0; the resolver only considered the 13.x branch and left the 11.x snapshot possible. The fix commits 50a7970efe9f and b89f2944995d both modify src/Illuminate/Http/Resources/JsonApi/Concerns/ResolvesJsonApiElements.php, the JSON:API resource feature that shipped in 12.45.0. The frozen v11.30.0 tree has no src/Illuminate/Http/Resources/JsonApi directory at all, so the defective inclusion/destruction path does not exist there. v11.30.0 predates the introduced version and is not affected.

notes: The frozen SHA is the v11.30.0 tag commit; all four candidates lie inside a published range that nominally contains v11.30.0, and each decision rests on the frozen source, not the range alone.

CVE-2024-13918 and CVE-2024-13919 share one fix commit, 45287fb2a91c (PR #53869, "Escape data"), which changes exactly two Blade echoes in the exceptions renderer context component. The pre-image lines are verbatim at the frozen SHA: line 54 {!! $exception->requestBody() ?: 'No body data' !!} and line 108 {!! $routeParametersContext !!}. Both rows are anchored on the raw echo; the producing methods (requestBody at Exception.php:155-164 and applicationRouteParametersContext at :189-197) are named in the summaries. Both require APP_DEBUG=true (Handler.php:841).

CVE-2026-102279 is closed not affected on source evidence: the fix b495ca2 splits allowHTML out of the tippy() call and the vulnerable allowHTML:true tooltip plus formatted-source component are absent at v11.30.0, where the shipped bundle uses allowHTML:!1 and the only tippy targets are escaped. The OSV "introduced 0" range is nominal for the 12.x feature.

CVE-2026-114508 is closed not affected because the 12.x range starts at 12.45.0 and the frozen tree predates the JSON:API resource feature entirely (no src/Illuminate/Http/Resources/JsonApi directory).

Severity: both promoted rows carry the NVD primary CVSS 3.1 6.1 MEDIUM score and vector; the GHSA records are MODERATE with their own AC:H vector (4.7) and that divergence is recorded in each admission_checks note.
